title: Riot Squad Punx Banana, Raspberry & Dragonfruit Nic Salt E-Liquid10ml
description: Banana, Raspberry & Dragon fruit from Riot Squad is a mouth-watering medley of tropical fruits and berry. This complex e-juice combines the creamy sweetness of Banana with the exotic mellow tang of Dragon Fruit, then adds a layer of sharp, tangy Raspberry for an exquisite bite most noticeable on the exhale. Riot Squad’s Punx Nicotine Salt e-liquids are formulated with hybrid nicotine, an innovative blend of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and salt nicotine and 50/50 PG and VG ratio provides the perfect balance of flavour and throat hit and makes this eliquid ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices.
